chapter_mission: Deliver the midpoint as an embodied crossing into full unweaving, then end on Ben's choice not to call Luke.
chapter_turn: Ben comes out of the breach with knowledge he cannot yet fully name and starts acting on it anyway.

scene_plan.purpose: Take the group into the zone and let Desh's measurements and the Force-users' reactions stop matching ordinary expectations.
Inside the breach, land the different responses and the two body-level facts Ben carries out of it.
Make the midpoint pivot one withheld action: the open channel, the missed call, the silence.

relationship_turns.to: verified partners — Desh's chrono-drift reading correlates with Ben's Weave-sense inside the zone. The correlation closes the loop of doubt Ben has been carrying since Ch 1. No one articulates this. It lands in how they stand next to each other leaving the zone.

exit_vector: The Steady Returns lifts away from Kolven with the wrongness now registered as enemy action felt rather than named. The comm panel to Luke stays closed. Every pressure dial crosses into red. Ch 14 opens with processing — the naming of what Veraine has been doing, the new route-decisions the array-dependency fact forces, and the first Luke-pressure the missed check-in generates.
notes: Keep the chapter physical. What matters is what the breach does to bodies, trust, and timing, not how elegantly anyone can describe it.
